Pharma AI 1.1.0 - what's new

- Self-serve setup: the Admin registers the company with a company e-mail and a 6-digit code (valid 24 hours).
- The app builds the company's own server on Supabase automatically, or on your company server, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud or another cloud provider with the included guides.
- 3-month free trial with complete access starts at once: no licence key, unlimited users and PCs.
- Other PCs join once with the PC connection code from the Admin, then sign in with username and password. IT can roll the code out to many PCs from a file.
- Licence per active user account; PCs are not counted. A10 shows the trial countdown, the active users and Buy 1-year licence / Buy lifetime licence. N Automations switches the licence on: no key to type, no reinstall.
- N Automations receives only the Admin's company e-mail and daily account numbers, never names, passwords, prompts, files or API keys.
- Security: file integrity check at every start, debugger detection, protected licence and sign-in code, and a signed licence status certificate checked by the company server and every PC.
- Get it from the Microsoft Store (signed by Microsoft, updated by the Store) or as the website installer with Admin-controlled updates.
- Eight guide PDFs (server setup, AI API key, PC connection) are included and open without internet.
- The app frame stays fixed in the window; the draft label is removed; About shows the full N Automations contact card.
